description: Owner privileges and structural properties of each token contract, as reported by GoPlus Labs' static analysis of the deployed contract. We do not decompile the bytecode ourselves. null means the source did not report that field — it does NOT mean the capability is absent.
structuralNote: isProxy and isOpenSource are NOT owner privileges. Upgradeable proxies are the standard deployment pattern for many established protocols; treating them as a warning would flag Aave, Arbitrum and Lido.
caveat: Trade-simulation verdicts (honeypot, cannot-sell-all, taxes) are excluded from this feed because they produce false positives on legitimate assets.
